in_sanskrit.name: Jheelika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus Lake
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jheelika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jheelika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jheel' meaning a lake or pond, and 'ika' meaning one. The name Jheelika represents the grace and beauty of a lotus lake, reflecting the calm and serene nature of the water and the life it nurtures.

in_hindi.name: जीलिका
